pain_point: Construction quality concerns off the plan - How do I know the build quality will be good if I'm buying off plans and renders?
primary_text: "How do I know the build quality will be good?" Fair concern — especially if you've seen dodgy apartment builds in the news. But industrial is a different game. These Truganina warehouses use steel portal frames, reinforced concrete slabs, and Colorbond cladding built to withstand commercial use for decades. Every unit comes with structural warranties and is built to meet all relevant Australian building codes. The builder has delivered multiple industrial estates across Melbourne's west. You can inspect completed projects, review specifications, and meet the construction team. Off-the-plan doesn't mean off-the-radar. You'll know exactly what you're getting.
description: Steel-framed, concrete-slab construction with full structural warranties
